title: How should locked project design become a personalized working room?
question: How should locked project design become a personalized working room?
answer:
BPR-7B2: Staged capability Specs: first a valid copyable Workbench Template; then project-evidence intake with a prepared Blueprint grilling notepad; then Genesis turning locked Blueprint and ADR decisions into Specs and a valid project Workbench; then fresh-copy end-to-end proof. Each stage proves its own seam, and the Blueprint keeps the full destination without claiming delivery.
BPR-7B1: For v3.2 it is enough that LLM Workbench applies the newly settled ownership and routing rules to update Workbench Template successfully. Fresh-copy personalization, prepared project grilling, Genesis completion and validation of a personalized Workbench are future capabilities; v3.2 must not claim them.
